heading, Meet our passionate group., level 3
Data Science & Real World Evidence Lead
Data Science & Real World Evidence Lead

We set up Ampersand Health with the goal of making life with a long-term inflammatory condition just a bit easier. We are a values-based company that puts the patient at the heart of what we do by wrapping digital, medical and social support around them. It’s a pleasure to be a part of this talented and motivated team as we strive to improve the lives of patients with these conditions.
AMPERSAND HEALTH CO-FOUNDER & JOINT CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER
